starting_checkpoint.optimizer_state: fresh AdamW; no optimizer state was saved in the old checkpoint

all_other_classifier_rows: frozen and bitwise checked, including cat and dog

training.per_update: one billboard-positive + one washing-machine-positive + two photos explicitly absent for both categories; preserve all targets/scopes on each photo
training.model_mode: eval with only two final classifier rows trainable
training.early_stop: At update 1000, stop if no eligible strict improvement over new-run step 0 has been selected. Otherwise continue to maximum 2000 updates.
training.validation_margin: Stop before the elapsed cap with sufficient margin for receipt/checkpoint finalization; a partial run is not a completed fixed-budget trial.

selection.guard: Every reviewed class individually: complete TP cannot decrease, complete FP cannot increase, partial known hits cannot decrease versus step0. Also total unscored predictions may rise by at most5 (drift alarm, not false-positive count).
selection.ranking: Among eligible checkpoints, increase total reviewed-positive hits, then complete-scope F1; exact ties retain earlier step. Step0 remains selected if none improves.

evaluation.adoption: Separate gate: no complete-scope FP increase or reviewed-positive recall loss on heldout and frozen video evidence; require useful strict gain. No automatic app integration.
evaluation.limits: Small purposive assistant-reviewed evidence; not statistically representative independent accuracy.

extra_guard: Reference new-run step 0 and original job 7780632 step 0. The original per-class counts are identical at old steps 0 and 600; verify this preflight. Never relax the original retention guard.
strict_gain_definition: An eligible checkpoint must increase the original lexicographic validation ranking. Ties retain new-run step 0. No claim of useful gain from confidence shifts alone.
limits: This tests a continuation with balanced exposure and more updates, not a causal ablation of every change.
Selected negatives are explicitly absent for both categories; unknown images are never relabeled negative.
Small assistant-reviewed dataset and repeated exposure can overfit; no general accuracy claim.
Read-only diagnostic gradients cannot establish the best learning rate or required update count.
approval_required_reason: The recorded approval authorized exactly one four-row 600-update GPU trial. That trial is complete; this proposed two-row continuation is a separate scope and job.
execution_package_status: Not created or submitted. These files freeze the reviewable proposed scope and sampler; an implementation must pass its contracts before manual remote submission.
